name: alcancia-video
description: Remotion product demo video for Alcancía

scripts.render: remotion render src/index.ts AlcanciaDemo out/alcancia-demo.mp4 --codec h264
scripts.stills: for f in 90 450 1200 1900 2580 2730 3060 3420 3600; do remotion still src/index.ts AlcanciaDemo out/still-$f.png --frame $f; done
scripts.render:sandboxed: remotion render src/index.ts AlcanciaDemo out/alcancia-demo.mp4 --codec h264 --browser-executable scripts/chrome-wrapper.sh
